## Purpose
`/libraries`: the document libraries grid, with search, sort, bulk delete and create.

## Responsibilities
`LibrariesIndexPage`:
- reads `librariesApi.list`;
- `LibraryCard`s;
- `LibraryFormDialog` creates a library;
- bulk delete through `librariesApi.remove` ("Library deleted.");
- empty states "No libraries match that search" and "No libraries yet".

Titled "Libraries — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`LibrariesIndexPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Library creation and deletion.
